scenes.title: Standards for readers
scenes.accessibleDescription: Clear responsibilities and names help the next human or agent.

scenes.title: No silent failure
scenes.accessibleDescription: A failed save should never appear to the visitor as success.

scenes.title: Test the boundary
scenes.accessibleDescription: Check inputs, outputs, authorization, and important non-effects.

scenes.title: Small verified slices
scenes.accessibleDescription: A coherent change pairs implementation with checks and evidence.

scenes.title: Levels of proof
scenes.accessibleDescription: Each evidence level says only what was actually observed.

scenes.title: Evidence and recovery
scenes.accessibleDescription: A result needs context; a failure needs a realistic recovery path.

scenes.title: Readable code
scenes.accessibleDescription: Purposeful names and narrow responsibilities make future diagnosis easier.

scenes.title: A useful error
scenes.accessibleDescription: Different readers need a clear remedy without exposing private data.

scenes.title: Test what must not happen
scenes.accessibleDescription: Negative tests prove important effects are prevented.

scenes.title: Where was it tested?
scenes.accessibleDescription: A fake provider and a live observation support different claims.

scenes.title: Review the change
scenes.accessibleDescription: Connect the change to its requirement, checks, risks, and rollback.

scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.accessibleDescription: A useful record lets another person assess the proof level.

scenes.title: Show the proof
scenes.accessibleDescription: Ask for the specific observation behind a broad quality claim.
